super_kupopower.label: Super Kupopower
super_kupopower.summary: Wings of the Goddess era Mog Tablets and King Kupofried's Super Kupowers: 11 tablets hidden across 29 field zones, the Explorer Moogle rewards, 11 powers (3 active per week) and the global/zone changes they make. Tablet locations are entered per zone with coordinates; every power, NPC and reward gets a status and a validation mark. Unknowns stay marked unknown.
super_kupopower.compare: Compare against captures (message ids, Explorer Moogle events) and in-game !logpos before marking anything ok.
